hypothesis: The only V2.3 contract failure is a representational boundary mismatch: supports_answer=false with a quote-only empty placeholder. A conservative deterministic normalization can restore the intended empty value without changing any semantic support verdict or previously valid row.

independent_variable.name: unsupported_answer_span_boundary_normalization
independent_variable.control: strictly require answer_span to be the empty string when supports_answer=false
independent_variable.intervention: strip surrounding whitespace and map only exact quote-only empty pairs to the empty string when supports_answer=false

decision_boundary.pass: Authorize only preregistration of a disjoint external fresh-generation memory holdout using the normalized carrier.
decision_boundary.fail: Reject this normalization or localize unintended semantic changes before any new model generation.

evidence_boundary: A passing replay proves only that a deterministic boundary normalization repairs the frozen known output without semantic drift. It does not prove fresh model-generation quality or authorize runtime use.
